A vacuum double-wall structure keeps drinks warm or cold, so it works for both hot and cold drinks.
The wide mouth makes it easy to add ice.

The 350 ml (about 11.8 fl oz) capacity is clearly listed, so you know how much it holds.

sections.p: The bottle has a vacuum double-wall structure that gives it both a warm-keeping and a cool-keeping effect. A handle makes it easy to carry and to pull out of a bag.
It holds 350 ml (about 11.8 fl oz), and the wide mouth makes it easy to put in ice. It comes in a dedicated box, which the seller recommends for presents and gifts.

Die weite Öffnung erleichtert das Einfüllen von Eiswürfeln.

cautions: Angegeben ist nur das Fassungsvermögen von 350 ml; bitte prüfen Sie die Produktfotos für Gesamtgröße und das Strawberry-Design, bevor Sie bestellen.
